first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation. Prior evidence indicates faster time-to-value, but the early-churn risk in complex-workspace accounts requires verification and a guarded test that excludes or preserves the full flow for that segment. Promotional pricing is less aligned with sustainable qualified revenue because prior gains came with materially worse retention.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding-simplification experiment for simple self-serve/SMB accounts only, while retaining the full flow for complex-workspace accounts. The verified evidence directly supports improved completion and faster time-to-value, and related SMB signup simplification improved activation and qualified revenue. Excluding complex workspaces protects against the verified 9% increase in 60-day churn. Results should not be generalized beyond the tested eligible segments.
